QUOTE: "`ServerManager::is_explicitly_allowed` matches the allow list (server_manager.cpp:286)" under the "Approval gate (`check_approval`, tool_executor.cpp:161-188)"; also "deny wins over both the allow list and auto-approve."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer puts the allow-list check (in server_manager.cpp) inside the approval gate (`check_approval` in tool_executor.cpp). It says the deny gate still runs afterwards, so the allow list only affects approval and does not grant execution. It never says "only", but the mechanism and the two locations are stated.
